text:
Priya N: quick heads-up — MidBank (Brazil) presales. They want a 6-week POC and two hard constraints: serve BR customer traffic from sa-east1, BYOK keys must be in BR KMS. They WILL accept Canada (northamerica-northeast1) only as DR in a real outage. Qs from their security team: where do request logs and audit trails live, and can we guarantee no metadata leaves BR unless explicitly allowed? Also need a short POC price and egress estimate for a single outage failover.

Omar K: thanks. Is this Hosted or Dedicated for the POC? Also need expected QPS and token/day to size.

Priya N: customer prefers Dedicated for predictability. Estimated peak ~9 req/s, ~45k tokens/day. POC length: 6 weeks. They also asked whether tenant-pin + BYOK requires extra contractual sign-offs.

Fiona L: TL;DR answers:
- Tenant-pin (strict) supported on Dedicated — compute, storage, and logs can be isolated to sa-east1.
- BYOK supported — customer must provision BR-region KMS key (recommend HSM). We require a BYOK addendum covering key lifecycle and responsibilities.
- Failover to CA allowed only on outage. When failover happens, cloud inter-region egress charges apply; we put those on the quote as a separate line item.

Fiona L: sample routing policy we suggest (short):
```yaml
policy_name: midbank_poc
mode: strict_pin
primary_region: sa-east1
failover_policy: outage_only
failover_targets:
  - northamerica-northeast1
kms_byok: true
log_replication: none  # unless customer signs opt-in
```

Omar K: important nuance — "logs" split: request payloads and CAPI audit trails can be kept in-region when strict_pin is on. Platform metrics (aggregated, non-identifying) are normally sent to central analytics; for regulated customers we can disable that and store metrics in-region for the contract term.

security-bot: checklist created: POC-2024-768 — deliverables: BYOK addendum draft, region-specific subprocessor list (BR + CA), pricing one-pager with strict vs soft pin delta + egress example, POC runbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/presales/POC-2024-768

Priya N: legal asked if BYOK implies we never hold key material — can someone confirm custody model?

Fiona L: confirmation: customer keeps key custody. We only receive a wrapped key/GRANTS per cloud provider patterns (we never hold plaintext key material). BYOK addendum will state: customer retains control, provides access grants, and is responsible for rotation; we support key revocation flows and will stop serving if key access removed.

ops-oncall: quick sanity checks for region endpoints (staging):
```bash
curl -s -I https://inference.sa-east1.redwood.ai/health | head -n1
curl -s -I https://inference.northamerica-northeast1.redwood.ai/health | head -n1
```
ops-oncall: to simulate DR failover in staging run: POST /router/overrides with body `{ "force_failover": "northamerica-northeast1" }` and monitor server_timing headers.

Omar K: pricing guidance (rough) for the POC:
- Dedicated baseline (6 weeks reserved): compute+infra ~ $3,200
- BYOK onboarding (one-time): $400 (legal + ops onboarding)
- Strict_pin delta vs soft_prefer: strict ~ +15% operational premium due to capacity reservation
- Egress worst-case single outage calc: avg_response_size=60KB, outage_failover_requests=2,000 -> egress=~120MB -> at $0.09/GB ~= $0.011 -> we round up and include a conservative buffer => $5/month line item for POC.

Priya N: can you make a single page quote with those lines and two scnearios (strict vs soft)? Ill attach to the customer invite.

Fiona L: I will draft the BYOK paragraph for legal and assemble the subprocessor excerpt for BR/CA (cloud provider, monitoring, edge). Will include explicit statement about no logs leaving BR under strict_pin and opt-out for aggregated metrics replication.

Omar K: Ill own the pricing one-pager and include a small worked example calc + a conservative egress cap for the POC. Ill also add a short note about token billing (unchanged) vs network egress (separate).

Priya N: great. Proposed timeline: drafts by EOD tomorrow, customer call next Tue 10:00 BRT. Owners: Omar -> pricing, Fiona -> BYOK/addendum + subproc, ops-oncall -> staging checks and runbook.

security-bot: action items recorded. Closing loop when docs uploaded to POC-2024-768. :white_check_mark:
